label: FortiSwitch 108F 8-port desktop switch (PoE PD on port 8)
description: Fortinet FortiSwitch 108F fanless desktop Layer 2 switch: 8x GE RJ45 (port 8 also accepts 802.3af/at PoE as a power input), 2x 1G SFP, 20 Gbps switching capacity, 30 Mpps. No PoE output.

fabric.note: Datasheet switching capacity 20 Gbps duplex with 30 Mpps: 2 x 10 Gbit/s, the line rate of eight 1G RJ45 ports plus two 1G SFP cages.

notes: Datasheet: 7x GE RJ45, 1x GE/POE-PD RJ45 and 2x GE SFP; 0 PoE ports and 0 W PoE budget; 20 Gbps switching capacity, 30 Mpps, 8 K MAC, 4 us latency, 4 K VLANs, 512 KB packet buffer, 256 MB DDR3, 32 MB flash, ACL 640, 32 spanning-tree instances, >10 years MTBF. Ports 1-8 are the RJ45 front panel and 9-10 the SFP cages (108F QuickStart Guide). Port 8 is a PoE PD input, 802.3af/at compliant: the box is powered either from the supplied 12 V DC / 1 A adapter or over the LAN from an upstream PSE, which is modelled as the 12.95 W 802.3af draw on port8 - this switch is a powered device, not a PSE. 30 x 120 x 180 mm, 0.62 kg, 6.2 W, fanless, desktop (19-inch bracket optional). Console is the rear RJ-45 (USB-to-RJ45 cable in the box); FortiSwitchOS default 115200 8-N-1 - not the 9600 a FortiGate uses (https://docs.fortinet.com/document/fortiswitch/7.6.5/enterprise-data-center-switching-with-evpn-vxlan-deployment-guide/313313/deployment-procedures; `config system console` baudrate default 115200 in https://docs.fortinet.com/document/fortiswitch/8.0.0/fortiswitchos-cli-reference/500379/config-system) - console port default 192.168.1.99 (QuickStart Guide). FortiLink ports 7-10. Layer 2 only: inter-VLAN routing, policy routing and L3 services are performed by the FortiGate over FortiLink, so no l3-forward is declared. Datasheet ordering text says dual powered while the specification table says 0 PoE ports; the table is right - dual power is DC adapter or PoE PD input. Every copper port declares poeOut 0 rather than staying silent: this model's own label mentions PoE, and the engine promotes every copper port of a PoE-capable switch to a PSE when the port says nothing about power.

label: FortiSwitch 108F-FPOE 8-port desktop PoE switch (130 W)
description: Fortinet FortiSwitch 108F-FPOE fanless desktop Layer 2 PoE switch: 8x GE RJ45 all 802.3af/at PSE (130 W budget), 2x 1G SFP, 20 Gbps switching capacity, 30 Mpps.

poe.note: 8 PoE ports, 130 W total (datasheet). 130 W covers eight Class 3 (802.3af, 15.4 W) devices at 123.2 W but only four Class 4 (802.3at, 30 W) devices at 120 W: 8 x 30 W = 240 W is not available, so the 30 W per-port ceiling is a port capability, not a promise to all eight at once. Internal AC supply, 100-240 V, 1.4 A max, 139.2 W consumption fully loaded.

fabric.note: Datasheet switching capacity 20 Gbps duplex with 30 Mpps: 2 x 10 Gbit/s, the line rate of eight 1G RJ45 ports plus two 1G SFP cages.

notes: Datasheet: 8x GE RJ45 and 2x GE SFP; 8 (802.3af/at) PoE ports, 130 W budget; 20 Gbps switching capacity, 30 Mpps, 8 K MAC, 4 us latency, 4 K VLANs, 512 KB packet buffer, 256 MB DDR3, 32 MB flash, >10 years MTBF. 44 x 209 x 250 mm, 1.84 kg, fanless, desktop or 19-inch bracket. All eight copper ports are PSE ports; the two SFP cages are not. The PoE MAX LED reads 130 W on the front panel (108F QuickStart Guide). FortiLink ports 7-10. Console is the RJ-45 serial port, FortiSwitchOS default 115200 8-N-1 (https://docs.fortinet.com/document/fortiswitch/7.6.5/enterprise-data-center-switching-with-evpn-vxlan-deployment-guide/313313/deployment-procedures), console default IP 192.168.1.99. Layer 2 only - routing is the FortiGate's job over FortiLink. The FS-108F-POE was left out of this batch: the datasheet table says 8 PoE ports while Fortinet's own switch page says 4, and no vendor document settles which of its eight ports source power.

label: FortiSwitch 124F 24-port rack switch, 4x 10G SFP+
description: Fortinet FortiSwitch 124F fanless 1 RU Layer 2 switch: 24x GE RJ45, 4x 1/10G SFP+ uplinks, 128 Gbps switching capacity, 190 Mpps. No PoE.

fabric.note: Datasheet switching capacity 128 Gbps duplex with 190 Mpps: 24x 1G plus 4x 10G is 64 Gbit/s of line rate, doubled to 128 Gbps full duplex.

notes: Datasheet: 24x GE RJ45 and 4x 10GE SFP+; 0 PoE ports, 0 W budget; 128 Gbps switching capacity, 190 Mpps, 32 K MAC, <1 us latency, 4 K VLANs, 2 MB packet buffer, 512 MB DDR3, 64 MB flash, ACL 640, 32 spanning-tree instances, >10 years MTBF. 44 x 230 x 330 mm, 2.03 kg, 24.8 W average / 26.3 W maximum, fanless, side-to-back airflow. Ports 1-24 are RJ45, 25-28 are the SFP+ cages; the cages take 1G SFP optics too, and FortiLink runs on ports 21-28, i.e. the last four copper ports plus the four cages (124F QuickStart Guide). No dedicated management port. Console is the front RJ-45 serial port at 115200 8-N-1 by default (https://docs.fortinet.com/document/fortiswitch/7.6.5/enterprise-data-center-switching-with-evpn-vxlan-deployment-guide/313313/deployment-procedures), console IP 192.168.1.99. Layer 2 only: routing is done by the FortiGate over FortiLink, so no l3-forward. The 230 mm depth is the non-PoE chassis; the PoE variants are 260 mm.

label: FortiSwitch 124F-POE 24-port switch, 12 PoE+ ports, 185 W
description: Fortinet FortiSwitch 124F-POE 1 RU Layer 2 PoE+ switch: 24x GE RJ45 of which 12 (ports 1-12) are 802.3af/at PSE against a 185 W budget, 4x 1/10G SFP+ uplinks, 128 Gbps switching capacity.

poe.note: 12 PoE ports (ports 1-12), 185 W total. 185 W is exactly 12 x 15.4 W, so the budget powers twelve Class 3 (802.3af) devices at full rate and only six Class 4 (802.3at, 30 W) devices - the 12 x 30 W = 360 W sum of the port ceilings is not available. Internal AC supply, 235.9 W average / 237.4 W maximum consumption.

fabric.note: Datasheet switching capacity 128 Gbps duplex with 190 Mpps: 24x 1G plus 4x 10G is 64 Gbit/s of line rate, doubled to 128 Gbps full duplex.

notes: Datasheet: 24x GE RJ45 and 4x 10GE SFP+; 12 (802.3af/at) PoE ports, 185 W budget; 128 Gbps switching capacity, 190 Mpps, 32 K MAC, <1 us latency, 4 K VLANs, 2 MB packet buffer, 512 MB DDR3, 64 MB flash, ACL 640, 32 spanning-tree instances. 44 x 260 x 330 mm, 3.56 kg, side-to-back airflow. PoE is on ports 1-12 only - the front panel labels PoE Ports 1 to 12 with a PoE MAX LED of 185 W, so ports 13-24 are plain GE and are modelled unpowered (124F QuickStart Guide). FortiLink ports 21-28; SFP+ cages 25-28. Console RJ-45 at 115200 8-N-1 by default (https://docs.fortinet.com/document/fortiswitch/7.6.5/enterprise-data-center-switching-with-evpn-vxlan-deployment-guide/313313/deployment-procedures), console IP 192.168.1.99. Layer 2 only - the FortiGate routes over FortiLink. Half the front panel is PoE and half is not, which is the easy thing to get wrong on this model: ports 13-24 state poeOut 0 explicitly because the engine otherwise promotes every copper port of a PoE-capable switch to a PSE.

label: FortiSwitch 124F-FPOE 24-port switch, 24 PoE+ ports, 370 W
description: Fortinet FortiSwitch 124F-FPOE 1 RU Layer 2 PoE+ switch: 24x GE RJ45 all 802.3af/at PSE (370 W budget), 4x 1/10G SFP+ uplinks, 128 Gbps switching capacity, 190 Mpps.

poe.note: 24 PoE ports, 370 W total. 370 W is 24 x 15.4 W (369.6 W): every port can run a Class 3 (802.3af) device, twelve can run a Class 4 (802.3at, 30 W) device, and 24 x 30 W = 720 W is not available. Internal AC supply, 449.8 W average / 451.3 W maximum consumption fully loaded.

fabric.note: Datasheet switching capacity 128 Gbps duplex with 190 Mpps: 24x 1G plus 4x 10G is 64 Gbit/s of line rate, doubled to 128 Gbps full duplex.

notes: Datasheet: 24x GE RJ45 and 4x 10GE SFP+; 24 (802.3af/at) PoE ports, 370 W budget; 128 Gbps switching capacity, 190 Mpps, 32 K MAC, <1 us latency, 4 K VLANs, 2 MB packet buffer, 512 MB DDR3, 64 MB flash, ACL 640, 32 spanning-tree instances. 44 x 260 x 330 mm, 3.82 kg, side-to-back airflow, smart fan. Every copper port is a PSE port; the four SFP+ cages are not. FortiLink ports 21-28; SFP+ cages 25-28 (124F QuickStart Guide). Console RJ-45 at 115200 8-N-1 by default (https://docs.fortinet.com/document/fortiswitch/7.6.5/enterprise-data-center-switching-with-evpn-vxlan-deployment-guide/313313/deployment-procedures), console IP 192.168.1.99. Layer 2 only - routing is the FortiGate's over FortiLink. Same 370 W as the 148F-POE spread over half as many ports, so this is the box that can feed 24 PoE+ devices at once.

poe.note: 24 PoE ports (ports 1-24), 370 W total. 370 W is 24 x 15.4 W, so all 24 PoE ports can power a Class 3 (802.3af) device but only twelve can power a Class 4 (802.3at, 30 W) device: 24 x 30 W = 720 W is not available. notes: Datasheet: 48x GE RJ45 and 4x 10GE SFP+; 24 (802.3af/at) PoE ports, 370 W budget; 176 Gbps switching capacity, 260 Mpps, 32 K MAC, <1 us latency, 4 K VLANs, 2 MB packet buffer, 512 MB DDR3, 64 MB flash, >10 years MTBF. 44 x 310 x 440 mm, 4.68 kg, side-to-back airflow. label: FortiSwitch 148F-FPOE 48-port switch, 48 PoE+ ports, 740 W
description: Fortinet FortiSwitch 148F-FPOE 1 RU Layer 2 PoE+ switch: 48x GE RJ45 all 802.3af/at PSE (740 W budget), 4x 1/10G SFP+ uplinks, 176 Gbps switching capacity, 260 Mpps.

poe.note: 48 PoE ports, 740 W total. 740 W is 48 x 15.4 W (739.2 W): every port can run a Class 3 (802.3af) device, 24 can run a Class 4 (802.3at, 30 W) device, and 48 x 30 W = 1440 W is not available. Internal AC supply, 100-240 V, 893.5 W average / 895.7 W maximum consumption fully loaded - close to a 10 A circuit at 230 V.

fabric.note: Datasheet switching capacity 176 Gbps duplex with 260 Mpps: 48x 1G plus 4x 10G is 88 Gbit/s of line rate, doubled to 176 Gbps full duplex.

notes: Datasheet: 48x GE RJ45 and 4x 10GE SFP+; 48 (802.3af/at) PoE ports, 740 W budget; 176 Gbps switching capacity, 260 Mpps, 32 K MAC, <1 us latency, 4 K VLANs, 2 MB packet buffer, 512 MB DDR3, 64 MB flash, >10 years MTBF. 44 x 310 x 440 mm, 4.68 kg - the same chassis and weight as the 148F-POE, which differs only in how many ports are wired for power. Every copper port is a PSE port; the four SFP+ cages are not. FortiLink ports 45-52; SFP+ cages 49-52 (148F QuickStart Guide). Console RJ-45 at 115200 8-N-1 by default (https://docs.fortinet.com/document/fortiswitch/7.6.5/enterprise-data-center-switching-with-evpn-vxlan-deployment-guide/313313/deployment-procedures), console IP 192.168.1.99. Layer 2 only - the FortiGate routes over FortiLink. PoE ceilings across this family are all af-multiples: 185 = 12 x 15.4, 370 = 24 x 15.4, 740 = 48 x 15.4, which is why the 30 W per-port ceiling is only available on a fraction of the ports at once.
